description: amFX reproduction (13JUN25 p1): NASDAQ 100 (QQQ) Sep-Nov 2024 showing geopolitical event reactions. source:
# =============================================================================
# AMFX REPRODUCTION: NASDAQ SEP-NOV 2024 GEOPOLITICAL EVENTS
# =============================================================================
# Reproduces page 1 chart from amFX 13JUN25 newsletter.
# NASDAQ (QQQ proxy) line chart showing Sep-Nov 2024 price action.
# Key events: Iran missile launch, Israel retaliation, US election,
# MSFT/META earnings disappoint. Geopolitics = noise, fundamentals matter.
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
idx = index()

# Moving averages for context
ma20 = ma(period=20)(close)

xy_lines(
    title='NASDAQ Sep-Nov 2024: Geopolitics vs Fundamentals',
    category='NASDAQ Geopolitical',
    y_axis_label='QQQ Price (USD)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='QQQ Close', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='20d MA', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    order=0
)(x_values=idx, y_values=(close, ma20))
